set.name: orders_app_tr
set.description: Turkish paraphrases of the orders_app questions; gold facts, negatives and corpus are the English set's, unchanged. In-sample: written by the author of the question-understanding rules while tuning them.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by reading every file of examples/orders_app line by line; each fact's source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before any approach is scored (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: question-understanding track agent, the author of the Turkish rules (textnorm / lexicon / question_plan), while tuning them
provenance.gold_written_by: copied unchanged from orders_app.json (benchmark harness author, round 1)
provenance.caveat: the paraphrases and the rules were written by the same author; Turkish results on these sets are an upper bound, not an independent measurement
provenance.original_file: qu_track/orders_app_tr.json (research scratch, not in the repository)

repoatlas_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)

sweep.rule: context cap = 4 x tokens characters for every approach; Graphify is given ceil(4 x tokens / 3) of its own 3-chars-per-token budget, raw char_cap = 4 x tokens, retrieve_text Budget(10, 4 x tokens) rendered at 4 x tokens chars

llm.status: not measured: llm='none' (use --llm anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set)

raw.note: no index; every query greps and reads the working tree

repoatlas.what: workflow.scan = Graphify-derived AST index (in-process) + snapshot (file hashes) + stale-claim check; warm = same tree again with the AST cache present
